description: This file defines a client wrapper for making HTTP requests to a backend API, including functions for URL building, request headers, query parameter handling, and specific API endpoints such as listing users, sessions, deployments, and costs. It also provides utility functions like backend health check and tenant summary retrieval.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Detects whether a URL string is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining a base URL with a relative path or URL, handling absolute URLs and removing redundant slashes.

methods.name: toQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Converts an object of parameters into a URL query string.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Checks if the provided path or URL points to the session-tracking collection root.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on specific endpoints to ensure only allowed parameters are sent.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Adds necessary scoping parameters like organization_id or tenant_id to query parameters based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams(pathOrUrl, effParams)
methods.description: Combines a URL or path with query parameters, merging existing query strings where necessary.

methods.name: parseResponse(res)
methods.description: Parses HTTP response, attempting JSON parsing if content-type is JSON, otherwise text.

methods.name: httpGet(pathOrUrl, { params, headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a URL with optional parameters, headers, and signal, returning response data or throwing on error.

methods.name: httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with method (e.g., POST, PUT), body, and options; handles JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes API list responses to a standard format containing items, total, and meta.

methods.name: getApiClient()
methods.description: Returns an object with get, post, put, delete methods mimicking axios, using fetch.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Checks backend health status, attempting primary endpoint, falling back to /api/auth/health.

methods.name: listUsers(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of users with optional query params; reflects /api/users endpoint.

methods.name: listSessions(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of session tracking records; enforces tenant scoping.

methods.name: listDeployments(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of app deployment records.

methods.name: listLlmCosts(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of LLM cost records.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict()
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary, ensuring only organization_id is sent as a query parameter.

ctags.name: httpJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {}) {$/
